name: Pipeliners - SEO Baseline 2026-09-10
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-09-10

# Summary
Rollup of the `seo-baseline-2026-09-10` work folder. The core document, `Pipeliners-SEO-Baseline-2026-09-10.md`, is the locked "before" picture (data through Sep 10, prepared Sep 11, read-only). The folder then became the working home for fixes, drafts and the running change log through mid-October.

# Key findings (baseline document)
- Control map: titles and metas served by OTTO (MetaSync); Rank Math inactive and its stored focus keywords inert; schema from OTTO, MetaSync breadcrumbs, Elementor FAQ and a posts mu-plugin; sitemap is the MetaSync virtual /sitemap.xml (126 URLs). OTTO had 1,731 items deployed and 2,753 pending; crawl frequency Never but autopilot on.
- Periods: baseline Aug 14 to Sep 10 vs Jul 17 to Aug 13; future window Sep 11 to Oct 8; first review Oct 9. Two GSC sources (Domain vs https URL-prefix) are never mixed.
- GSC Domain: 57 clicks, 25,161 impressions, position 48.4 (was 44.1). Branded clicks +50%, non-branded -14%. About half of all Google clicks come from the GBP website button (http UTM link), invisible to the URL-prefix property.
- Impressions shifted from local city pages (-15.5%) to national blog content (+20.5%) that ranks 60 to 90 and does not convert.
- GA4: organic 164 sessions; all-channel sessions +68% from paid traffic with no extra leads. GBP actions -40%.
- OTTO review: pending "missing keywords" (1,234) include gas, pipe bursting and other states (do not approve); wrong-city image alts on 36 of 37 city pages; app/rental schema; 122 frozen hidden homepage links.
- Priority 1 list: hidden OTTO content, broken tap-to-call links, unreliable lead measurement, invalid schema, sitemap hygiene, unindexed key pages, GBP link URL, OTTO queue policy. Priority 2 and 3 cover page-1 queries with no clicks, striking distance, Buckeye's pipe-break loss, Paradise Valley, city internal links, GBP corrections and longer-term local, AEO and GEO work.

# Decisions and status
- Fixed Sep 12 (approved, verified, logged): hidden OTTO text rolled back (hidden words 20,648 to 0 in OTTO modules), 4 broken tel: buttons fixed, 9 incorrect OTTO schemas undeployed.
- Later in this folder: Indexing Phase 1 (Sep 12), sitemap and GSC cleanup (Sep 14 to 15), Step 7 and Step 8 city pages and quick wins (Sep 15 to 17), blog merges (Sep 19), more city page drafts through Oct 10.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `Pipeliners-SEO-Baseline-2026-09-10.md`: the baseline (own summary above).
- `Pipeliners-Page-Baseline-2026-09-10.csv` (149 rows), `Pipeliners-Keyword-Baseline-2026-09-10.csv` (235 queries), `Pipeliners-Technical-Baseline-2026-09-10.csv` (43 checks), `GA4-Channels-...csv`.
- `Pipeliners-SEO-Change-Log.csv`: see its own note.
- `Pipeliners-Indexing-Phase1-2026-09-12.md`, `blog-indexing-investigation-2026-09-17.md`, `blog-merges-draft-2026-09-17.md`: own notes.
- City page drafts (step7, step8, quick-wins, headings, gold-canyon, maricopa, scottsdale-anthem-surprise, anthem-rewrite, scottsdale-content-refresh): see the City Page Drafts note.
- `cast-iron-draft-2026-09-26.md`: draft new sections for /how-long-do-cast-iron-pipes-last/ (cast iron sewer lifespan underground; no external links because no .gov or .edu source was found).
- `pipeliners-search-plan.html`, `step8-apply/` (before, after and cached HTML of the Step 8 pages), `fix-backups/` (JSON, PHP, XML and robots before/after copies from Sep 12 to Sep 19; raw backups, not summarized).
